evidence_scope: Only the overall R/F/S value is updated; the selected non-H2 candidate remains fixed. Disabled interventions measure return to H2; enabled interventions measure added execution. Each category's contribution divides its paired sum by the full within-lifecycle common terminal cohort before averaging lifecycles, so contributions sum to the overall effect. Conditional category means are descriptive. Cutoffs retain cost and are removed jointly across five methods. V83-V86 construction is inherited; past validation/evaluation is not new work. Shared method attributions are not additive wall time.
